text:
sophi: quick eyes please on PR #8476? small shim for js client to preserve legacy Content-Length behavior when falling back from streaming to rest. should be low-risk but want 1-2 reviewers for merge window :wave:

ben: on it, will check headers + unit tests. ping me if you want perf numbers too.

kevin: skimmed — main question: do we always set Content-Length on fallback or only when original request had it? looks like current impl unsets it in some cases which broke a downstream proxy.

sophi: we set it only when caller included `content-length` originally, but there was a bug where the streaming path cleared it on error. PR adds `preserveContentLength` flag and copies header from the saved request.

hannah: left two tiny comments on parameter naming and a changelog line. otherwise LGTM.

ben: running the e2e locally now. small script I used:```bash
# emulate streaming failure then fallback
curl -v -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Content-Length: 42" -d '{"input":"x"}' http://localhost:8080/v1/generate
```
expected: server sees Content-Length on the fallback request.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #8476 (jobs: unit, e2e, lint).

ci-bot: unit tests failed in `node-14` on `client/headers.test.js` — assertion about preserved header. looks like a flake or a real change.

ben: saw the failing test, repro'd locally. small timing race in the mock server — pushing a fix in a followup commit.

kevin: approve after tests. also can someone run a quick perf check for memory/regression? we touch request cloning.

sophi: @ben could you run the perf harness (10k small requests) and paste p99? would like to ensure no token CPU regression.

ben: perf harness done, before: p99 48ms, after: p99 52ms — small bump, within acceptable.

hannah: approved — added changelog entry and test adjustment.

ci-bot: all checks passed for PR #8476.

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for merge commit ab12f4c — will run canaries after merge.

kevin: merging now. thanks all for quick reviews :tada:

sophi: thanks team! will watch canaries and open a rollback if anything weird shows up.

deploy-bot: staging canaries healthy after deploy (5m) — no errors observed.

sophi: marking this done, will close the followup perf PR tomorrow.
